# DeSpain Consulting

> AI-powered operations consulting for small businesses and founders. We remove the friction that's costing businesses time and money, using AI-powered systems that fit how they actually work. Based in Park City, Utah, working with clients worldwide.

DeSpain Consulting was founded by Anne DeSpain, who brings 20+ years of retail operations experience from Amazon, Myer, Sundance Catalog, J.Crew, and Limited Brands. The firm helps small businesses, founders, and purpose-driven brands put practical AI automation to work: working systems that hold up in day-to-day operations, tested first in businesses we own and operate ourselves.

## Services

- **AI Opportunity Audit ($350):** A 30-minute strategy session plus a personalized audit report, delivered within 24 hours, mapping the highest-value AI opportunities to your specific operations. Backed by a satisfaction guarantee: at least three actionable opportunities or a full refund. The fee is credited toward a follow-on build. [Book or learn more](https://despain-consulting.com/services/)
- **Get Started with AI ($150, introductory founding rate):** A 60-minute one-on-one video session for individuals at any level, from people who have never opened an AI tool to daily users who want to go further. You leave with your AI tools set up, a short personalized AI plan, and prompts for the things you do most, plus a working workflow or scheduled task if you're ready for it. Full refund if you don't finish the hour with a tool set up and a starting plan you understand. [Book or learn more](https://despain-consulting.com/start)
- **Custom and bespoke projects:** Ongoing strategy, implementation, or a fractional AI operations partner, scoped to each business.

## Problems We Solve

- Manual work eating the team's time
- Decision-making without good data
- Scaling bottlenecks that require adding headcount
- Reactive firefighting instead of proactive systems
- Margin erosion from untracked inefficiencies
- AI confusion: knowing it matters but not knowing where to start

## Approach

Start with the problem, not the technology. Build for how the business actually works. Transfer knowledge to build internal capability instead of ongoing dependency.

## Case Studies

- **Programmatic ad system (Wasatch Gift, Mother's Day 2026):** $138.12 in ad spend over 15 days, 8.06% click-through rate, $0.11 cost per click, 24 orders and $6,625 in revenue during the campaign window, 47.97x blended return on ad spend.
- **Invoice data entry:** PDF invoices are read and their vendor, date, line items, and unit costs appended to a margin-planning spreadsheet in about 30 seconds per invoice.
- **Operations knowledge assistant (Magnolia):** A Slack-based assistant for a historic property, backed by a structured knowledge base of vendors, maintenance schedules, HOA contracts, and preservation requirements.

Full details: https://despain-consulting.com/case-studies/

## Business Ventures

- [Wasatch Gift](https://wasatchgift.com): Curated artisan gift e-commerce featuring Utah local makers, gift personalization, and brand storytelling
- [mAIker](https://maikerco.etsy.com): AI-themed print-on-demand shop on Etsy

## AI Systems Built

- **Programmatic Ad System:** Generates, previews, and uploads ad campaigns across Meta and LinkedIn from a single command, for B2C and B2B audiences
- **Invoice Tracker:** Automated cost data extraction from PDF invoices into a margin-planning spreadsheet
- **Magnolia:** Slack-based home and property management agent for a historic property
- **College Scout:** Agentic research automation for college exploration ([try it](https://collegescout.vercel.app))
- **Print Marketing Guru:** Custom GPT providing benchmarks and KPIs for print marketing campaigns ([try it](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-675338a3335c8191a8148d87ed288630-print-marketing-guru))
- **Document Generation Workflow:** Multi-agent orchestration with one main agent coordinating 7 specialized agents for complex document workflows
